input.quote: The Company hereby grants to HDI a non-exclusive, limited, non-transferable license to use the Company's "Deerskin" trademarks, service
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no ownership or intellectual property clause anywhere. HDI designs, develops and hosts the Site (§§1.1-1.3) and holds our Content, user information and order data (§8.1), yet nothing states who owns the Site deliverables, the Content or the customer/order data generated through the Site. The only IP-adjacent provision is the limited trademark license to HDI in §6.1 (which is properly narrow and benefits us), and §5.2 gives us artistic and editorial control but not ownership. With no ownership clause and no license-back, the rule's fallback is not met either, so we have added a new §5.5 confirming that we own the Site deliverables, Content, Marks and Company Data, that HDI retains its pre-existing platform IP subject to a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to us, and that there is no joint ownership.

ops.text: 5.5 Ownership. As between the Parties, the Company owns and shall retain all right, title and interest in and to (i) the Content, the Marks and all other materials furnished by the Company, (ii) the Site and all designs, layouts, code, documentation and other deliverables and work product developed by HDI for the Company under this Agreement (excluding HDI Pre-Existing IP), and (iii) all customer, order and transaction data collected or generated through the Site in connection with Deerskin Products ("Company Data"). HDI hereby assigns to the Company all right, title and interest in and to such deliverables, work product and Company Data. HDI shall retain all right, title and interest in and to its pre-existing software, platform, systems, tools and know-how, including improvements thereto ("HDI Pre-Existing IP"), and hereby grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, non-exclusive license to use, modify and sublicense any HDI Pre-Existing IP embedded in or necessary for the Company's use of the Site and such deliverables for its business. Nothing in this Agreement assigns or grants to HDI any ownership interest in the Company's intellectual property, the Marks, the Content or Company Data, and no deliverable, work product or Company Data shall be jointly owned.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement is silent on ownership, even though we pay for the Site through the Net Sales share and supply the Content, Marks and all customer and order data, so we have added a short ownership clause confirming that we own the Site deliverables, Content and Company Data with no assignment of our IP to HDI. HDI keeps its pre-existing platform and tools and grants us a perpetual, royalty-free license to any of that IP embedded in the Site, which we regard as the balanced position.
proposal.summary: Add Section 5.5 (Ownership): Company owns Site deliverables, Content, Marks and Company Data; HDI retains pre-existing platform IP and grants a perpetual royalty-free license-back; no joint ownership.
